# [postcss][postcss]-normalize-unicode

> Normalize unicode with PostCSS.

## Install

With [npm](https://example.invalid/package/postcss-normalize-unicode) do:

```
npm install postcss-normalize-unicode --save
```

## Example

### Input

```css
@font-face{
    font-family: test;
    unicode-range: u+2b00-2bff
}
```

### Output

```css
@font-face{
    font-family: test;
    unicode-range: u+2b??
}
``` 

## Usage

See the [PostCSS documentation](https://example.invalid/postcss/postcss#usage) for
examples for your environment.
